GOVERNMENT OF TELANGANA
OFFICE OF THE COLLECTOR AND DISTRICT MAGISTRATE, JANGAON
(Chairperson, District Management Committee, Sakhi One Stop Centre)
Notification No.01/SAKHI/2026 Dated: 05.10.2026
Sub: Mission Shakti (Sambal) – Sakhi One Stop Centre, Jangaon – Engagement of personnel in
all thirteen posts on outsourcing basis – Written examination on Sunday, the 11th October
2026 – Notification issued.
Ref:
1. Mission Shakti Scheme Implementation Guidelines of the Ministry of Women and
Child Development, Government of India, para 3.1 and Annexure IV.
2. Government Memo No.1968/Prog.I/1/2023, dated 29.08.2023 of the Department for
Women, Children, Disabled and Senior Citizens.
3. Lr.No.1037/TS/OSC/2014, dated 22.01.2024 and 16.07.2024 of the Commissioner,
Women Development and Child Welfare, Hyderabad.
4. Memo No.1637/MS-SNA SPARSH/2025, dated 17.07.2025 of the Director, Women
Development and Child Welfare, Hyderabad.
5. Proceedings Rc.No.COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026, dated 05.10.2026 of the
Collector, Jangaon, on the engagements made through the support agencies.
* * *

by the District Administration. All thirteen posts of the Centre are to be filled afresh by open
selection, as ordered in the reference fifth cited. Applications are invited from eligible
candidates for engagement, on outsourcing basis, in the posts shown below.

3. A candidate shall have completed 21 years and shall not have completed 45 years of age on
01.10.2026. For ex-servicemen and retired personnel of the para-military forces applying for
the post of Security Guard the upper age limit is 55 years. For persons now working in the
Centre the upper age limit is relaxed by the period of their service in it.
4. Experience will be counted only where the certificate shows the post held and the dates of
joining and relieving, and is supported by the appointment order and proof of payment such as
bank statement, pay slips or EPF record. Field work, project work or internship done as a
student, and voluntary service, will not be counted. A certificate issued by a non-Government
organisation shall carry the registration number of the organisation and, where it has one, its
NGO Darpan identity number. Every certificate relied upon will be referred to the issuing
authority for confirmation.
5. Selection will be by a written examination followed, on the same day, by an oral test of 25
marks. The selection list will be declared the same day.
(a) For the posts at Sl.No.1 to 6 the written examination carries 200 objective questions for
90 minutes, in English. Part A of 100 questions is common to these posts. Part B of 100
questions is on the subject of the post applied for.
(b) For the posts at Sl.No.7 and 8 the written examination carries 100 objective questions for
60 minutes, in English and Telugu, and is common to both posts.
(c) In both papers each question has five options and carries one mark. One fourth of a mark
will be deducted for every wrong answer. Nothing is deducted for a question left
unanswered. Answers are marked on an OMR answer sheet. The syllabus is in Annexure
II.
(d) The key will be displayed at the venue at 12.00 noon on the day of the examination.
Objections to the key, in writing and with proof, will be received at the venue up to 12.45
PM and decided before the result is declared.
(e) The result of the written examination will be displayed at the venue at 2.00 PM.
Candidates will be called the same day for verification of original certificates and the
oral test, in the order of marks in the written examination, at three candidates for each
vacancy. Every candidate shall therefore bring all original certificates to the venue and
remain there till the result is displayed. A candidate who is absent when called, does not
produce the originals, or is found not eligible, will be passed over and the next candidate
called. No other date will be given.
(f) In the oral test each candidate will answer five questions drawn from a question bank.
Each answer will be marked out of five by the Selection Committee on a scoring sheet,
which forms part of the record.
(g) The selection list for each post will be drawn in the order of the total of the marks in the
written examination and the oral test. Where the total is equal, the candidate with more
marks in the written examination, and then the candidate older in age, will be placed
higher. The list will be declared the same evening. It is provisional, and subject to
confirmation of the certificates by the issuing authorities, verification by the Police and
medical fitness. A waiting list will be kept for one year.
6. The schedule is as follows.

7. Applications in the form in Annexure I, with self attested copies of the certificates listed in it
and two passport size photographs, shall be handed over at the Inward Section of the
Collectorate, Integrated District Offices Complex, Jangaon, from 06.10.2026, between 10.30
AM and 5.00 PM on working days and between 10.30 AM and 1.00 PM on Saturday, the
10.10.2026, on which day the Inward Section will remain open for this purpose. The hall
ticket will be issued across the counter on receipt of the application. Applications sent by
registered post or speed post shall reach the Collectorate by 1.00 PM on 10.10.2026, and the
cover shall be superscribed with the name of the post. Applications will not be received at the
office of the District Welfare Officer or at the Sakhi Centre. A candidate may apply for one
post only. There is no application fee.
8. Admission to the written examination is provisional. The venue will be announced on the
district website https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in and on the notice board of the Collectorate
by 09.10.2026. Candidates who applied by post shall collect the hall ticket at the help desk at
the venue between 8.30 AM and 9.15 AM on the day of the examination, on production of an
identity card. The candidate shall bring the hall ticket, an identity card in original, all original
certificates and a blue or black ball point pen, and shall report by 9.00 AM. No candidate will
be admitted after 9.45 AM. Mobile phones, calculators and other electronic devices are not
allowed in the examination hall.
9. The conditions of engagement are as follows.
(a) The engagement is on outsourcing basis, through the agency selected by the District
Committee under Notification No.02/WCD/2026, as required in the reference second
cited. It is for one year at a time. Continuance depends on the annual performance
appraisal, on the continuance of the scheme and on the release of funds. It confers no
right to regularisation or to any post under the Government.
4
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6265/2026
(b) Verification of character and antecedents by the Police and a certificate of medical
fitness from a Government hospital are required before engagement, as laid down in
para 3.1 of the guidelines first cited.
(c) The Centre works round the clock on all days. The persons engaged shall work in shifts,
including night shifts, and shall reside at Jangaon.
(d) Contributions to EPF and ESI will be regulated as per law.
(e) Persons who have worked or are working in the Centre may apply for any one post for
which they hold the qualification. Their service in the Centre counts as experience. No
other preference or weightage will be given to them.
(f) Canvassing in any form will disqualify the candidate. A candidate who furnishes a false
certificate or suppresses any fact will be removed at any stage and is liable to
prosecution.
(g) No travelling allowance will be paid for attending the examination or the oral test.
10. The rule of reservation and the Telangana Public Employment (Organisation of Local Cadres
and Regulation of Direct Recruitment) Order 2018 will be followed, as required in Circular
Memo No.17944/668/A2/SMPC/2007, dated 06.10.2007 of the Finance Department. A roster
is opened for each category of post with this selection and the posts are filled in the order of its
points. One post each of Case Worker, Multi Purpose Staff and Security Guard falls at the
second point of the roster and is reserved for the Scheduled Castes, in the group to which that
point is assigned in the roster in force. The other posts are open competition. Local candidates
of Jangaon District, as defined in that Order, will be selected first in the order of merit. A
candidate who is not local will be considered only where no local candidate is found eligible.
11. The Collector may modify or cancel this notification or vary the number of posts.
12. The key, results and all notices will be placed on the district website and on the notice board
of the Collectorate. No individual intimation will be sent.

Scheme and syllabus of the written examination.
For the posts at Sl.No.1 to 6 the paper carries 200 questions in two parts. Part A is common and
carries 100 questions.
Sl.No. Subject Questions
1 General knowledge and current affairs, with reference to Telangana and Jangaon
District
20

3 Constitution of India: fundamental rights, directive principles and the provisions
relating to women and children
10
4 Laws relating to women and children: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence
Act 2005; Sexual Harassment of Women at Workplace Act 2013; Dowry Prohibition
Act 1961; Prohibition of Child Marriage Act 2006; Protection of Children from
Sexual Offences Act 2012 and Rules 2020; Juvenile Justice Act 2015; Immoral
Traffic (Prevention) Act 1956; PCPNDT Act 1994; offences against women and
children in the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita 2023 and the connected procedure in the
Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023
30

Part B is on the subject of the post and carries 100 questions.
Post Syllabus
Centre Administrator Guidelines and standard operating procedure of the One Stop Centre; supervision
of case management from intake to closure; duty rosters and management of
staff; records, registers, the web based case management system and monthly
reports; funds, accounts, PFMS, utilisation certificates and statements of
expenditure; convergence with the police, hospitals, courts, legal services
authority, shelter homes and Child Welfare Committee; basics of counselling;
office procedure and correspondence.
Psycho Social
Counsellor
Schools and skills of counselling; psychological first aid and crisis intervention;
trauma and its effects on women and children; assessment of risk of self harm
and safety planning; common mental disorders and referral; child and adolescent
psychology; counselling of the family and the respondent; the Mental Healthcare
Act 2017; documentation of counselling, ethics and confidentiality.
Case Worker Methods of social work: case work, group work and community organisation; the
case management cycle of intake, risk assessment, safety planning, referral,
follow up and closure; counselling skills and psychological first aid; gender and
violence against women; working with the police, hospitals, courts, shelter homes
and Child Welfare Committee; rehabilitation and livelihood schemes for women;
documentation of cases; ethics and confidentiality.
9
COLLJN/PESH/GNRL/0077/2026-ADMINISTRATIVE OFFICER O/O DCO I/6265/2026

Criminal procedure from FIR to judgment, including zero FIR, arrest, bail,

guardianship under the personal laws and the Special Marriage Act; property and
succession rights of women; legal aid under the Legal Services Authorities Act
1987; victim compensation under section 396 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha
Sanhita and the Telangana Victim Compensation Scheme; offences against
women under the Information Technology Act 2000; drafting of complaints,
petitions and applications.

nursing; guidelines and protocols of the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
on medico legal care for survivors of sexual violence; collection and preservation

maternal health; mental health first aid; infection control and bio medical waste;
medical records and referral.

computer knowledge

entry, databases and management information systems; web portals and online

OFFICE OF THE COLLECTOR AND DISTRICT MAGISTRATE, JANGAON
Notification No.01/SAKHI/2026, dated 05.10.2026
Applications are invited for engagement on outsourcing basis in all thirteen posts of the Sakhi One
Stop Centre, Jangaon, under Mission Shakti: Centre Administrator (1), Psycho Social Counsellor
(1), Case Worker (2), Para Legal Personnel / Lawyer (1), Para Medical Personnel (1), Office
Assistant with computer knowledge (1), Multi Purpose Staff / Cook (3) and Security Guard / Night
Guard (3). Age: 21 to 45 years as on 01.10.2026. Selection is by a written examination with
negative marking on Sunday, 11.10.2026, at 10.00 AM, with the oral test and the result on the same
day. Candidates shall bring their original certificates. Applications in the prescribed form will be
received at the Inward Section of the Collectorate, IDOC, Jangaon, from 06.10.2026 up to 1.00 PM
on 10.10.2026, and hall tickets will be issued across the counter. Persons working in the Centre
may also apply. The qualifications, experience, reservation, syllabus, form of application and
conditions are in the detailed notification on https://jangaon.telangana.gov.in and on the notice
board of the Collectorate.
